Title: Create and manage Azure WebJobs in the Azure Preview portal

Body.Content: Azure WebJobs can now be created and managed in the Azure Portal preview. The portal will support On Demand WebJobs and Continuous WebJobs. This feature is accessible in the portal on the Website blade and through the WebJobs button, which opens the WebJobs blade. You can also use the Console to interact with your WebJobs directly, and use the WebJobs SDK to make authoring easier. Learn more about Azure WebJobs.
Body.Markdown:
Azure WebJobs can now be created and managed in the Azure Portal preview. The portal will support On Demand WebJobs and Continuous WebJobs. This feature is accessible in the portal on the Website blade and through the WebJobs button, which opens the WebJobs blade. You can also use the Console to interact with your WebJobs directly, and use the WebJobs SDK to make authoring easier.

Learn more about Azure WebJobs .
